authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a control change the document says the instrument recognises, or a row of its NRPN table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
CC 4 (Foot Pedal (Pdl)) is read-only: the document lists it as transmitted, not recognised.
CC 7 (Volume (Pdl)) is read-only: the document lists it as transmitted, not recognised.
CC 10 (Panpot (Pdl)) is read-only: the document lists it as transmitted, not recognised.
CC 65 (Portamento SW (ASW)) is read-only: the document lists it as transmitted, not recognised.
CC 82 (Foot SW (ASW)) is read-only: the document lists it as transmitted, not recognised.
Not a parameter here, Bank Select, part of preset recall: CC 0, 32.
Not a parameter here, Data Entry, part of the NRPN messages: CC 6.
Not a parameter here, an NRPN or RPN selector, part of the NRPN messages: CC 98, 99.
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, 121, 123, 124, 125.
Left out, printed without a range: NRPN 00 02H (Arpeggio On/Off), 05 00H (Voice Mode), 05 04H (Vocoder SW).

201 parameter(s) by SysEx PARAMETER CHANGE (F0 42 3g 00 01 18 41 pp PP qq QQ vvl vvm vvh F7): an ID and a sub-ID of 14 bits and a value of 21, each low seven bits first, resolved through the tables' nested blocks. NOTE 4 calls the value signed; a negative one is sent as two's complement, which is how this profile reads it; not yet tried on an instrument.
Left out, a run of IDs for the characters of one setting: program name (00:00~0B).

Left out, it is printed without a value: Timbre A OSC 1 CTRL1, Timbre A OSC 1 CTRL2, Timbre A OSC 2 CTRL1, Timbre A OSC 2 CTRL2, Timbre A OSC 3 CTRL1, Timbre A OSC 3 CTRL2, Timbre B OSC 1 CTRL1, Timbre B OSC 1 CTRL2, Timbre B OSC 2 CTRL1, Timbre B OSC 2 CTRL2, Timbre B OSC 3 CTRL1, Timbre B OSC 3 CTRL2, Arpeggio Timbre Assign.

Left out, the value is printed as "same as Band1": Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band2 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band3 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band4 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band5 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band6 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band7 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band8 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band9 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band10 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band11 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band12 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band13 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band14 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band15 parameter, Vocoder Formant Hold Data Band16 parameter.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.
